//: Typechecks the TypeScript build/QA scripts under scripts/. The main tsconfig pins rootDir to src/, so scripts cannot simply be added to its include — they need their own program. Without this a .ts script is run by tsx but never typechecked, and its calls into src/ rot silently: publishing-pdf-qa passed bundledFontPath/latinModernPath long after generateDesignedStyleTex stopped accepting them, so the PDF harness quietly stopped exercising the shipped font path. Inherits the main compilerOptions untouched apart from rootDir/noEmit — overriding lib or types here breaks the src/ files these scripts pull in transitively. src/**/*.d.ts is listed explicitly because ambient declarations (globals, and the obsidian augmentation in src/types/obsidian-augment.ts) are not picked up transitively.
